feature_manifest.name: hop_count
feature_manifest.description: Total count of parsed Received email routing hops

feature_manifest.name: max_hop_delay_sec
feature_manifest.description: Maximum delay in seconds detected across routing hops

feature_manifest.name: body_char_count
feature_manifest.description: Total character count of plain text email body

feature_manifest.name: body_entropy
feature_manifest.description: Shannon entropy score of plain text email body character distribution

feature_manifest.name: uppercase_ratio
feature_manifest.description: Ratio of uppercase characters to total body text length

feature_manifest.name: urgency_word_count
feature_manifest.description: Occurrences of social engineering and urgency lexicon keywords

feature_manifest.name: html_to_text_ratio

feature_manifest.description: Total count of URLs extracted from email body text and HTML

feature_manifest.description: Count of raw IP address literal URLs detected in payload

feature_manifest.name: mismatched_anchor_count
feature_manifest.description: Count of deceptive anchor text links mismatching netloc/domain

feature_manifest.name: attachment_count
feature_manifest.description: Total count of extracted email attachments
